source_claim: TV Tokyo's official Yowamushi Pedal character page individually profiles Onoda Sakamichi, Naruko Shoukichi, Makishima Yuusuke, Manami Sangaku, and Toudou Jinpachi. TV Tokyo's official staff/cast page independently lists their cast and identifies the source as Wataru Watanabe's manga serialized by Akita Shoten.
notes: The TV Tokyo character page lists all five exact characters: https://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/yowapeda2013/chara/. Its official staff/cast page identifies the manga source and repeats the exact names: https://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/yowapeda2013/staff/. The current official anime cast list is also at https://yowapeda.com/cast/.
